description: One page from one capability, charged per call or per item returned, also when an answer that reached the data source is empty, not found or failed. Give the capability and only the parameters describe lists for it. The first lines of the answer give the items, the charge, the balance, the result ID and how to go on: cursor for the next page (a new charged call), read_more for the rest of an answer cut at about 20 KB (free). Then one JSON item per line. Needs an API key.

advertiser.description: The advertiser's name. Give query or advertiser. (one capability takes it)

board.description: Which list: hot searches is the only one.

brand.description: The brand name, spelled the way the Douyin index lists it.

capability.description: The capability ID, from find or this list.

category.description: Only notes of this content category, as written in the creator detail’s categories. A category that does not exist finds nothing.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. US, JP.

cursor.description: page.next_cursor of the previous call, for the next page (a new, charged call).

domain.description: The brand's website domain. Give id or domain. (one capability takes it)

duration.description: Only videos of this length. (one capability takes it)

engagement_min.description: Engagement rate of the last 30 days at least this, in percent: 3 means 3%. (one capability takes it)

feature_tag.description: Only notes with this content feature tag, as written in the creator detail’s ext.feature_tags. A tag that does not exist finds nothing. (one capability takes it)

fields.description: Keep only these fields, by dotted path (author.name), to save tokens.

filter.description: Only verified accounts, or only those live now.

format.description: Only text, image or video ads; all by default. (one capability takes it)

gender.description: Only female or only male creators.

id.description: The ID of the post, account, video... the capability is about.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A new unique value (a UUID) lets you resend a call whose answer did not arrive: the same value returns the first result, charged once.

ids.description: Several IDs for one batch call; describe gives the most it takes.

keyword.description: One keyword, as typed into the search box.

keywords.description: One to five keywords, each without a comma. Give keyword or keywords. (one capability takes it)

lang.description: Preferred transcript language. The result's lang is the track actually returned.

limit.description: Entries per platform, from its top (1 to 50; 10 by default). (one capability takes it)

list.description: Which list: Best Sellers (the default), New Releases, Movers & Shakers, Most Wished For or Gift Ideas. (one capability takes it)

max_price.description: The most this call may cost, in US dollars as text, e.g. "0.05". A call that could cost more is refused and not charged.

media.description: Only image or only video ads; all by default.

name.description: The advertiser's name as on its Facebook page. Give id or name. (one capability takes it)

platforms.description: Comma-separated platforms to include, any of weibo, zhihu, douyin, bilibili, xiaohongshu, kuaishou; all of them when left out. (one capability takes it)

post_id.description: The shortcode of the comment's post.

published_within.description: Only posts from the last day, week, month or year.

query.description: Keywords, as typed into the platform's search box.

search_by.description: Match the words against what creators post (the default) or against their names.

shop_id.description: The shop ID: ext.shop_id in a product's details, or the number in a shop<id>.taobao.com link. (one capability takes it)

sort.description: Order; describe lists the values each capability takes.

status.description: Ads running now (the default), stopped ones, or both.

tab.description: Which tab of the account's page: articles (the default), videos or pictures.

tmall_only.description: Only Tmall shops. (one capability takes it)

traffic.description: Which traffic the reads count: all, promoted traffic included (the default), or organic traffic alone. Likes and saves stay the same. (one capability takes it)

url.description: A share link or page address, in place of id.

username.description: A handle, in place of id.

view.description: How much of each object: brief keeps only IDs, title, the first 100 characters of text, link, time and the main counts (scan a list with brief, then get the items worth reading by ID); compact leaves out empty fields and cuts long text at 500 characters; standard keeps every field; full adds platform extras under ext. compact when left out.

window.description: Look back this many days; 30 by default.

name: call
title: Call a capability
